verdict.rationale: Firstbase's pricing page lists unlimited incoming-mail scans with unlimited digital storage on its business-address plan, and in-app file digitization. Together these suggest received documents are kept in the account rather than only forwarded at notification time. The evidence never ties this storage to registered-agent service-of-process notices, and never states retention periods or how archived items are retrieved later. Missing for 10: explicit archiving of registered-agent legal notices, a documented retention period or archive/search UI for retrieving notices months later, independent or hands-on corroboration.
